name: Neural Irradiance Volume
definition: A neural-based technique that compresses the 5D irradiance field of a scene into a compact pre-computed model to compute indirect diffuse illumination at real-time rates, overcoming aliasing and memory limitations of grid-based probe methods.
summary: Neural Irradiance Volume is a real-time technique that compresses indirect diffuse irradiance into a neural model, enabling noise-free shading of dynamic objects without ray tracing.
